description: This file contains unit tests for the AssistantTextParser class/module, verifying its ability to parse and handle text segments with specific markup tags.

classes.name: AssistantTextParserTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing unit tests for the AssistantTextParser functionalities.

methods.name: splitsThinkAndFinalSegments
methods.description: Tests that the parser correctly splits segments based on <think> and <final> tags.

methods.name: keepsTextWithoutTags
methods.description: Verifies that plain text without markup tags is treated as a single response segment.

methods.name: ignoresThinkingLikeTags
methods.description: Ensures that incorrectly named tags similar to <thinking> are ignored, and content is parsed as a response.

methods.name: dropsEmptyTaggedContent
methods.description: Checks that empty tags like <think></think> result in no segments.

methods.name: hidesThinkingSegmentsFromVisibleOutput
methods.description: Verifies that segments marked with <think> are hidden from the visible output when using visibleSegments.

methods.name: thinkingOnlyTextIsNotVisibleByDefault
methods.description: Ensures that thinking segments are not visible unless explicitly included via includeThinking parameter.
